brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, a prime ministerial candidate, accused caretaker Premier Benjamin Netanyahu on Friday of stoking a "racist" campaign targeting Israel's Arab minority, The Guardian reported. The statement marked a rare instance of a prominent Jewish political leader publicly defending Arab Israelis against the premier's rhetoric.

Details of the specific allegations and Netanyahu's response were not included in the available summary.

title: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of racist campaign against Arab Israelis
